_comment: Intended overlay overrides for scripts/test-skills-compose.mjs. `dest` suppresses the clobber on that destination file; `reason` MUST say why it is intentional. Two kinds: (1) 'intended override' — a feature skill's real implementation replaces a scaffold stub (permanent). (2) 'latent' — a real manifest smell kept green for now but worth fixing; should shrink to zero.

allow.reason: intended override: iblai-vibe-auth's real authenticated home page replaces the scaffold agent-template home.
intended override: iblai-vibe-auth's real auth-utils replaces the scaffold base stub.
intended override: iblai-vibe-auth's real config replaces the scaffold base stub.
harmless: the scaffold agent template re-uses iblai-vibe-agent-chat's OWN asset (same source file), so no content is lost.
harmless: the scaffold agent template re-uses iblai-vibe-agent-chat's OWN asset (same source file).

latent: iblai-vibe-scaffold maps BOTH its base and agent template variants (assets/base/lib/config.ts.j2 and assets/agent/lib/config.ts.j2) to one dest, so the render test only exercises the last. Split the variants or test them separately, then remove this entry.
